name: ISWC check-digit formula drops the final mod-10 wrap
why: org/ISRC.org item 7's whole point is a CORRECT check digit, verified against ISO 15707's own published formula and cross-checked against two independent real examples (org/ISRC.org's own T-034524680-1 and debug/artist-works-initial.html's T-070.127.339-3). Dropping the outer `% 10` changes the computed digit whenever `sum % 10` is 0, and more subtly can format an off-by-one digit as a two-character string, silently breaking the equality check against the single-digit code.
grep: a wrong check digit is flagged

name: initIswcValidation() never flags an invalid ISWC
why: Without this, a wrong check digit — the exact data-entry error this feature exists to surface — renders identically to a correct one, and the 📊 dropdown's new Validity section never appears.
grep: a wrong check digit is flagged

name: isIswcCol column-name gate is wrong (never matches)
why: Without this gate the ISWC Validity counters never run, so the 📊 dropdown offers no ISWC section at all — a silent, page-wide feature loss, same class of bug as its ISRC counterpart.
